name: read_message_window
description: Read a bounded character window of one message's content or reasoning from another role instance's conversation. Read-only. The window is capped, so read incrementally rather than asking for a whole message at once.

detailed: Reads a bounded slice of one message's content or reasoning.
friendly: Peek at part of a message.
whimsical: Peeks through the keyhole at one spot on the page.

detailed: tool {participantRole} is reading a message window
whimsical: Reading one line at a time

start.description: The character offset to start reading from (0-based).

end.description: The character offset to stop reading at (exclusive). The window is capped, so a large range reads only the first cap-many characters.
